description:
Post-MVP. An MCP server (exposed to the user's own agent/editor) with tools for writing and updating requirements/checks in `CHECKS.md` files, so requirements can be authored conversationally. Distinct from the MVP's internal `report-check-result` guardrail (one tool, in-process): this is a separate, user-facing server whose tools mutate `CHECKS.md` on disk — different concerns and lifecycle.

———
